```{r definitions, echo=FALSE, results='hide'}
## Packages for maps (only if maps are requested)
## Missing packages are installed automatically (internet connection required).
install_if_missing <- function(pkgs) {
  miss <- setdiff(pkgs, rownames(installed.packages()))
  if (length(miss) > 0) install.packages(miss)
  invisible(miss)
}
if (map_draw) install_if_missing(c("sf", "RColorBrewer"))
```


```{r setup, include=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
## ---- Packages -------------------------------------------------------------
## Missing packages are installed automatically (internet connection required).
pkgs <- c("tidyverse", "knitr", "skimr", "tinytex")
missing_pkgs <- setdiff(pkgs, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) install.packages(missing_pkgs)

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(skimr)

## ---- Global chunk options -------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = TRUE,    # display the code in the document
  eval    = TRUE,    # chunks are run, unless eval=FALSE is set explicitly
  message = FALSE,   # hide R messages
  warning = FALSE    # hide R warnings
)
knitr::opts_knit$set(width = 75)
options(max.print = 75)

## ---- Data availability ----------------------------------------------------
data_file <- "allgre.PB_V26.RData"
data_ok   <- file.exists(data_file)
if (!data_ok) {
  warning("File '", data_file, "' not found in ", getwd(),
          ": data chunks are skipped.")
}
```

# Statement

## Objectives of the Part 2

Part 1 gave the framework of the project (topics, unit of analysis, evaluation protocol). Part 2 guides you through the **data handling**:

- load the survey data and **check the structure** (one row per route, immobile persons, identifiers);
- **create and modify variables** with R, and with MongoDB;
- reduce the database to the **trip**, **person** and **household** levels (`allgreD`, `allgreI`, `allgreM`);
- compute **indicators by area** and draw **maps** of the Grenoble area (average daily travel time, number of trips, share of immobile persons).

You will then continue with the data handling for **your own topic**.

## Loading the data

First lets load the data

```{r eval=TRUE}
load("allgre.PB_V26.RData")
load("allgre_3DF.RData")
```
